title: 18.28. Saraṇaduka, Mahantaradukādi
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Saraṇaṁ sārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasaraṇo nasārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Araṇaṁ sārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasaraṇo nasārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā dve …pe… aññamaññe ekaṁ …pe… vipāke ekaṁ …pe… avigate dve. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
